events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRUNR

The National Weather Service in Rapid City has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Mellette County in south central South Dakota...
Eastern Jackson County in southwestern South Dakota...
Haakon County in west central South Dakota...
East Central Meade County in west central South Dakota...
Southern Ziebach County in west central South Dakota...

* Until 1000 PM MDT /1100 PM CDT/.

* At 901 PM MDT /1001 PM CDT/, severe thunderstorms were located
along a line from 5 miles northeast of Red Scaffold to 8 miles
northeast of Long Valley, or along a line from 18 miles southwest
of Dupree to 20 miles south of Kadoka, moving east at 25 MPH.

HAZARD...60 MPH wind gusts.

SOURCE...Automated observations. This line of thunderstorms has a
history of producing multiple measured wind gusts of 55 to
65 MPH.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Philip, Kadoka, Cherry Creek, Milesville, Midland, Belvidere, Cedar
Butte, Ottumwa, Billsburg, Kirley, Bridger, George Town, Corn
Creek, Red Scaffold, Nowlin, Intersection of Highway 73 and White
River, Takini, Intersection of Highway 63 and BIA Road 8 and
southwestern Cheyenne River Reservation.

This includes Interstate 90 in South Dakota between Mile Markers 143
and 174.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Crowley, CO; Otero, CO; Pueblo, CO
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Crowley County in southeastern Colorado...
Northwestern Otero County in southeastern Colorado...
Northeastern Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until midnight MDT.

* At 900 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Rocky Ford, Fowler, Ordway, Swink, Manzanola, Olney Springs, Sugar
City and Crowley.

events.region: Indian Wells Valley; Mojave Desert Slopes; Mojave Desert
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with several days of Major to
Extreme heat risk.

* WHERE...Indian Wells Valley, Mojave Desert, and Mojave Desert
Slopes.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Thursday to 11 PM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Long duration extreme heat with no overnight
relief will affect health systems, industries and infrastructure.
The entire population within the Watch is at risk for heat related
illnesses. Please prepare ahead of time to find air conditioning or
a cooling shelter before the heat arrives.
